The object has the characteristic rectangular shape with rounded corners and two circular cutouts for spools, plus a central rectangular window. However, the surface texture appears to be fabric or felt rather than smooth plastic. There is a label in the center with illegible, gibberish text that mimics the layout of a cassette label but fails to render readable characters.
